steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve! Stop! Don't let the contamination control you!

Your shouts, of course, don't work. The one controlling these toys is no longer Eve, but Mania itself. The toys are trying to trip you one after another, and you can only keep stepping over them or kicking them away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop! This is the Rust, and the contamination level here is already high. If Mania continues to accumulate, it may attract wandering Corruptors from nearby. If the crisis spreads, it will be beyond my control!
The disturbance caused by the toys is growing bigger by the second, and even the floor is starting to tremble. Your voice is drowned out by the cacophonous noise.
There's no way that Eve can hear your shouts. You're almost deafened by the noise yourself.

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Hahahaha, so many tears, so much longing! How pitiful...</color>

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Even though you know that the toys are fake, and that everything about the factory is fake, you still want to stay with these illusions!</color>

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Silly child! I'll help you, then! I'll help you stay with these toys forever and ever!</color>

The giant toy bear is still only in its premature form. Judging by the scale of the toys rushing towards the center, it will take some time to fully form. But even so, it is already terrifying, and you have to raise your head to see its head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Looks like you've had a hand in the creation of this terrifying toy factory, huh?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You'd devour anything... even the grief and longing for one's family. You're really shameless.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then I'll make you spit out everything you've devoured.
You've regained the confidence of your human form, and focus on the last bit of silver hair peeking out from the pile of toys. Kicking aside the toys in your way, you stride towards Eve.
She's still there! There's still time!

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Yes! Just like that! Feed me! Give everything to me!</color>

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>You only have me! Only I understand you! I will fulfill your wish for you!</color>
The monster is "growing" non-stop. It makes no difference whether you're a doll or human... it simply looks down on everything. And right now, it wants to steal more power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve, wake up! Don't be fooled by it!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It can't fulfill any of your wishes! It just forces you to stay in the past, brings forth your sorrows, and exploits your emotions!

The monster is furious at you, and the ground trembles again. You almost lose your balance, but you seize the moment to dive into the mountain of toys. As the last bit of Eve is about to be swallowed up by the toys, you finally reach your target.

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Don't come over here! Stay back! What are you trying to do?!</color>

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Eve! I need more power! Give me more power! Stop him!</color>
steps.female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>Eve! I need more power! Give me more power! Stop her!</color>

steps.content: Paying no heed, you cling tightly to the monster and shove the photo in your hand into the center of the toy pile. You know that Eve must be there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I brought you the real voices of your family.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve, don't you want to listen to them?
